notes: Already owned. Lightest of the three (31.1 lb) with the cleverest pack — the DualRetract fold tucks the wheels in. Car-seat side is the simplest: ONE universal adapter (~$60) covers Nuna/Cybex/Maxi-Cosi/Britax/Diono (it does NOT cover Graco/Chicco/UPPAbaby). Best in-stock price $679.99 (ANB Baby). Target's $543.99 was a sale price but OUT of stock when checked; Strolleria/Swaddles list $679.99 but backordered/sold out. MSRP per bobgear.com is $679.99.
